caption: The drawing shows two brown, oval-shaped objects that resemble stones, placed one on top of the other, positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The bottom object is larger and irregular in outline, with a mottled texture created by different shades of brown and gray, while the top object is smaller, smoother, and similarly colored with dark specks. The objects cast a slight shadow beneath them, suggesting a light source above and to the left. There are no other objects or details in the composition, which is minimalistic, and the only additional marking is a small handwritten inscription or signature in the lower right corner.
title: Stone Carved Out to Hold War Paint
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
